redFirst.basis: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/measure-affected-miss.py` in a throwaway tree at HEAD: inline suite tools/measure-affected-miss.py (its test file is its implementation file): it is new at HEAD, so there is no HEAD copy to hold its implementation at; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Added tools/measure-affected-miss.py (inline suite, 20 cases via tools/_suite.run) and pointers in tools/affected.py (docstring) and CONTRIBUTING.md. Mutation half: for each of the last task commits, scratch worktree at that commit (hooks pointed at nothing, removed in finally), tools/affected.py --json --base <parent> run in it, then each of two mutations (import-time raise; annotation the AST lint reads) applied to every changed .py, the full sweep run, reds not selected collected; each is rerun alone under the mutation (not flaky) and alone on the unmutated commit (not already red) before it counts; a mutation turning nothing red prints inert; a commit with no Python, a full-set selection, or an unreadable selector/sweep is named and never counted as a zero. CI half: gh run list --status failure, gh run view --log-failed per run in the window, failing suites (final summary block per job) checked against the selection for that run's own SHA; gh missing/unanswering prints could-not-ask with the reason; unreadable runs named. Flags: --commits --rev --repo --sweep-cmd --affected-cmd --budget-minutes --no-ci --ci-only --ci-since --ci-limit --json. Gate: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/measure-affected-miss.py exit 0, 20 cases; full python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --quiet exit 0, 192/192 files ok; ruff check clean; vermin -t=3.8- clean. Acceptance (4): fixture case m13 (status, HEAD, worktree list, scratch dirs identical before/after) and the real runs left git status of the tree identical (diffed against a pre-run snapshot). MEASURED RESULT (acceptance 5), NOT 20 commits: the time budget ran out. Range measured: 9 consecutive task commits ea05966b7..260b2c732 (newest 260b2c732 = P131.15-dau, oldest ea05966b7 = P131.4), requested 20, 11 not examined. One sweep (the whole tree) is roughly 7 to 12 minutes under load and each non-full-set commit needs two, so the run stopped starting commits after 105 minutes. Result: misses 3 of 9 commits (mutation). Of the 9, 4 had a full-set selection (cannot miss) and 5 were mutated: P131.12 b2405c56f 49 raise misses (a raise in audit-status.py, _status_facts.py or run-test-gate.py reddens 71 suites, the selection named 22 of them; confirmed by hand on test__doctor_hygiene: unselected, green clean, red mutated) plus 1 style miss; P131.10 f26def62e 6 raise misses plus 1 style; P131.4 ea05966b7 2 raise (test__filed_returns, test_drive_phase) plus 1 style; P131.14 3 and P131.11 6 had 0 misses (raise red 2 each, all selected; style inert). 60 miss rows in all, 3 distinct commits; the style miss is always tests/test__output_lints.py, a suite the selector does not pick for a changed .py (it picks test__output.py). Commit f26def62e was first NOT MEASURED (the sweep's own nested fixture FAIL lines were misread), the parser was fixed to read only the final summary block, and that commit was re-measured alone: the other eight commits were measured before the fix, and their confirmed misses were real paths. CI half over the same window found 0 failed runs (asked, answered). CI half over a wider window --ci-only --ci-since 2026-10-09: 27 of 39 runs name a failing suite their SHA's own selection did not pick (77 suite rows, 27 distinct suites); this is an UPPER bound, since a suite already red before the commit, platform-only and flaky reds are counted. Both selections are the one each commit carried (that commit's own affected.py). Logs: /tmp/mam-real.log /tmp/mam-real-c8.log /tmp/mam-real-ci.log. The brief said run in the foreground; the Bash tool caps a foreground call at ten minutes, so the long runs were backgrounded and waited on. Not run: the verify.sh slices other than the sweep, so check-example-ledgers and measure-context were not exercised.
outcome.descriptive: A measurement tool for how often the affected-test selection misses a red suite, and a first reading: 3 of 9 recent task commits missed (mutation), 27 of 39 failed CI runs since 2026-10-09 named a suite not selected.

testsAdded: inline suite in tools/measure-affected-miss.py: readers (m1 sweep output incl. nested block and incomplete run, m2 CI log, m3 mutations, m4 selection, m5 task log), fixture-repository cases (m6 miss counted and named, m6b no-python commit, m7 already-red suite not a miss, m8 selection holding every red counts zero, m8b full set, m9 inert mutation, m12 unreadable sweep, m13 checkout unchanged, m14 scratch dir inside checkout refused, m15 CLI, m16 second-run-green not a miss), CI half (m10 no gh prints could-not-ask, m11 stub gh counts K of J and names misses, m17 --ci-only, m18 answered-but-empty wording)
